# v1.1.0 - Bulk Assignment, Advanced Filtering and Improved Walkthroughs

Entra Extensions Manager v1.1.0 is a non-breaking minor release that adds bulk
value updates, easier single/bulk assignment access, advanced target filtering,
and a clearer guided walkthrough for Schema and Directory Extensions.

## Key Changes

- In write mode (Edit mode), apply extension values to one or multiple selected
  objects, or all matching objects across one or multiple declared directory
  target types. Discovery follows every page without a target cap.
- Access single-object assignment and Bulk Assign/Update side by side. Existing
  directory single-object assignment and Bulk Update menu routes remain available.
  Schema single assignment selects exactly one object and requires confirmation.
- Combine built-in Entra property filters with AND: display name, UPN, mail,
  department, job title, company name, account enabled, user type, group type,
  membership rule, security/mail enabled, direct group or administrative unit
  membership, object type, and object ID, where applicable.
- Filter using every standard ExtensionAttribute1-15 on users and devices.
  Text supports Equals, Not Equals, Contains, Starts With, Ends With, Is Empty,
  and Is Not Empty; boolean and membership conditions use appropriate operators.
- Apply/Clear controls separate property targeting from display-only quick search.
  Confirm the refreshed count and conditions before writing; see progress and
  per-object results. Tables display 50 rows per page without limiting the target set.
- Walkthroughs now introduce the tour first, then navigation and access mode,
  followed by page tasks. Single and bulk steps spotlight their respective
  buttons. Includes an assignment-dialog walkthrough and updated screenshots,
  guides, About help, tooltips, and reproducible demo examples.

## Compatibility and Scope

Existing definitions, directory single assignment, dry-runs, Open Extensions,
authentication, app registrations, and runtime configuration remain compatible.
No data migration or additional permission scopes are required. Unrelated
application functionality is unchanged.

Bulk updates support User, Group, Device, Application, AdministrativeUnit, and
Organization where declared by the extension. Mailbox-bound schema targets
(Contact, Event, Message, Post) remain explicitly flagged and excluded.
ExtensionAttribute1-15 filtering uses `onPremisesExtensionAttributes` for users
and `extensionAttributes` for devices; these are criteria, not attributes written
by this operation. Inapplicable properties exclude that object type.

Membership conditions use direct membership and GUIDs, not transitive membership.
Graph still enforces roles and permissions. Hidden membership may require
`Member.Read.Hidden`, which this application does not request; failed discovery
blocks writes rather than using a partial target list.

Supported predicates narrow Graph queries; other operators are evaluated locally
page by page. Broad or local-only filters may take time in large tenants. Graph
advanced indexes are eventually consistent. Successful writes persist and are
not rolled back if another object fails; bulk updates are not transactional.

## Deployment and Upgrade

1. Download `entra-extensions-manager-v1.1.0.zip` and extract it.
2. For upgrades, back up your configured `config.js`, replace deployed static
   files, then restore it before serving the site. For new deployments, configure
   the runtime client ID and hosted HTTPS redirect URI in `config.js`.
3. Retain or configure your SPA routing fallback and matching registered redirect
   URI. Source deployments can use their existing environment configuration with
   `npm ci` and `npm run build`.

The ZIP includes the static app, configuration template, README, changelog,
release notes, license, hosting configuration, environment reference, and user
guides with screenshots. The browser-only, delegated-permission security model
and modern-browser requirements are unchanged.

See the [README](../../README.md), [Bulk Update guide](../../docs/bulk-update.md),
and [Wizard walkthrough](../../docs/assignment-wizard.md) for deployment and usage.
